deadline_basis_options.physical_arrival_before_deadline: task succeeds when physical target-region entry is at or before deadline
deadline_basis_options.host_confirmation_before_deadline: task succeeds only when the completion message is legally received and confirmed at or before deadline

records.physical_arrival_time: simulator clock time of target-region entry
records.completion_message_send_time: time the public completion notice is sent; null message id means transport drop
records.host_confirmation_time: time the host legally receives the completion notice; null is unknown/not received
records.deadline_classification: computed only under the explicitly selected deadline_basis

policy_fusion: candidate-specific prior or auxiliary score with unchanged environment reward
